cohort: 269 women with AH or EC who underwent fertility-sparing treatment
finding: Women with AH or EC managed conservatively for fertility preservation had a live birth rate of 62%, but with higher rates of labor induction, cesarean section, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: This study on pregnancies after fertility-sparing treatment for AH/EC found a 62% live birth rate, with higher rates of labor induction, cesarean section, and postpartum hemorrhage compared to the general population.
gest_age: Not specified, but outcomes such as preterm delivery and full-term delivery were measured
